title: 2.1 blocker: pin ComfyUI to 7db08fe50 so a mid-sampling Stop no longer kills the engine
description: v0.41.0 dynamic VRAM aborts with CUDA illegal memory access on a Stop mid-sampler (Comfy-Org/ComfyUI#17115). Fix #17178 is one commit past v0.42.0, no tag carries it: pin the commit and make every install path honour it.
